    if strip is None: return grid
    best,(srow,erow)=strip

    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]

    # order existing shapes by slot index
    have=[c for c in keycols if c in existing]

        cs=groups[color]
        dr=top-min(i for i,_ in cs)
